scope: Candidate dynamic scene evaluation; scenes/inputs not yet frozen or held out, not numerical tests or proof of mastery
requiredEvidence: actual live visual review by independent reviewer
temporal samples when motion is tested
acceptance: Each applicable criterion >=3/4 with reasons; no contradicted physical claim; unavailable required visual evidence blocks acceptance. Not a scientific realism metric.

cases.task: Move one point light around a matte object
cases.expected: Predict changes from surface normals and occlusion; do not paint a fixed highlight

cases.task: Orbit a camera around fixed matte and metallic objects
cases.expected: Separate view-dependent reflection from diffuse body appearance

cases.task: Increase emitter size at fixed documented intensity convention
cases.expected: Compare contact and penumbra geometry; note brightness confound

cases.task: Replace a nearby neutral wall with a red wall
cases.expected: Inspect indirect color contribution without changing object albedo

cases.task: Compare thin and thick colored glass
cases.expected: Do not substitute CSS opacity for refraction/absorption

cases.task: Compare clear air with illuminated haze
cases.expected: Distinguish extinction and in-scattering; no universal blue-distance rule

cases.task: Hold scene fixed and change exposure then view transform
cases.expected: Separate scene-linear values from display appearance; no base-color compensation by default

cases.task: Animate light and camera on separate tracks
cases.expected: Review multiple frames and transitions for coherent shadow/highlight motion

cases.task: Predict material match under a narrow-band LED from only hex values
cases.expected: Refuse guaranteed spectral prediction and identify missing evidence
